design.status_of_evidence: Lee2019 participants and pairs as in C3/C4 (independent of HS-Stroke, not of C3/C4); EEGNet on the C4 window variants has never been run
design.model: R4/Paper A EEGNet-8,2 exactly as in C2/C3b (kern 64 at 128 Hz, 100 epochs, batch 64, Adam 1e-3, max-norm); input window-local 2-s windows, 20 channels x 256 at 128 Hz, per-window channel z-score
design.variants: V0.0 [0,2) s (100 % overlap with the scored window), V1.0 [1,3) (50 %), V2.0 [2,4) (0 %, same MI episode), P [-2.5,-0.5) (0 %, same trial pre-cue fixation)
design.pairs: C3 pairs; per task an outcome-blind random quarter (rng [7421, participant, run]); arms C + v(a) / C + v(b) for every variant, one A/A per task; <= 48 arms per GPU group; CRN within pair (all 8 arms of a pair)
design.estimands: C4 formulas; 54 participants; t95 CI; MC sign-flip (1e6, seed 7499); Holm over S1-S5; S5 compares the participant-level fraction d(V2.0)/d(V0.0) of EEGNet with that of C4 TS+LR on the same pairs (guard: not computed if any participant's d(V0.0) <= 0.5 points)
design.fail_closed: as C2 (non-finite output, A/A mismatch, missing group, commitment mismatch -> BLOCKED)

hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.basis: C3b: EEGNet exact-copy effect confirmed on Lee2019 (+13.29, 54/54); C4 (TS+LR, same pairs): about 91 % of the exact-copy advantage needs shared samples; residual = same-trial state (d(V2.0) 1.21 ~ d(P) 1.32)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H1_primary: d(V0.0) for EEGNet on 2-s windows differs from 0; declared direction > 0
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.H2: monotone decrease d(V0.0) > d(V1.0) > d(V2.0) (participant means; reported met / not met)
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.S5_two_sided: EEGNet's per-participant fraction d(V2.0)/d(V0.0) differs from TS+LR's (C4) on the same pairs; no direction declared; guard: not computed if any participant's d(V0.0) <= 0.5 points
hypotheses_declared_before_any_fit.no_SESOI: no equivalence region and no post-hoc relevance threshold
